government.title: The Government
government.description: Overview of the Government of the Republic of Astoria, its organisation and its missions.
government.lead: This section presents the organisation of the Government of the Republic of Astoria: its composition, its services and how to contact it.

paragraphs.p1: The Government directs and coordinates the policy of the Nation. It is made up of the head of government and the ministers in charge of the various ministerial portfolios.
paragraphs.p2: This portal aims to make government action more legible: the organisation of institutions, official announcements, related procedures and services are progressively documented here.

government.notice: The detailed presentation of the institutions and their missions is being drafted for this preview foundation.

composition.title: Government composition
composition.description: The composition of the Government of the Republic of Astoria: presidency, council of ministers and public administrations.
composition.lead: The Government of the Republic of Astoria is organised around the presidency of the Republic, the council of ministers and the public administrations.

paragraphs.p1: The official list of the members of the Government (head of government, ministers and secretaries of state) and the allocation of ministerial portfolios will be published in this section.
paragraphs.p2: Each institution will have a dedicated page: missions, organisation, news and related procedures.

composition.notice: The detailed composition will be published as soon as official data is available.

news.title: News
news.description: Official news from the Government of the Republic of Astoria.
news.lead: Find here the official communications, announcements and press briefings of the Government of the Republic of Astoria.

paragraphs.p1: The institutional news feed is being prepared. It will publish official statements, speeches and council of ministers' summaries.

news.notice: No news has been published on this portal yet.

services.title: Services and procedures
services.description: Access to online procedures and public services of the Government of Astoria.
services.lead: This section will centralise access to online procedures and the main public services of the Republic of Astoria.

paragraphs.p1: The procedures presented on this portal will be progressively made available: identity and official documents, employment and training, family and everyday life, businesses and territories.

services.notice: The first online procedures are currently being prepared.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: Contact the services of the Government of the Republic of Astoria.
contact.lead: The official contact channels of the Government of the Republic of Astoria are presented below.

paragraphs.p1: For any question regarding the information published on this portal, you can write to government services using the official email address.
paragraphs.p2: Press enquiries and institutional requests have dedicated channels, documented in an upcoming version of this page.

paragraphs.p1: This section will present the analysis published by the Government: expert analyses, cross viewpoints and opinions on the major topics of public action.

decryptages.notice: The first analyses will be published in an upcoming version.
